title: Grain Boundary Linear Configuration Schema
description: Configuration for creating a linear grain boundary.

actual_angle.description: The actual angle between the two phases

core_ring_sizes.description: Ring sizes of the dislocation core along both boundaries, sizes n with sum(n - 6) = 0, as [5, 7] or [5, 5, 8]; [6] for hexagons only

homo_bonds.description: Bonds between atoms of one element at the boundaries of a binary honeycomb: alternating (the grains are mirror images with the elements swapped), none (hetero bonds only), or an element symbol (plain mirror images, the first boundary rich in that element, the second in the other)
